news.headline: Bogota mayor presses Chinese-led consortium for more metro workers as auditors flag delays
news.summary:
Bogota mayor Carlos Fernando Galan has called on the Chinese-led consortium building the city’s first metro line to send more workers to its stations, after the country’s top auditor warned that delays in several parts of the project could push back its opening in March 2028.
